Date 22/2/36

Subject Communication dated February 10, 1936, from the H.B.M. Consulate
General concerning P.B. Silin, ex-Warder No. 16 of the Shanghai
Municipal Gaol.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J.B.Rm D.I.

Peter Boris Silin, Russian emigrant, was born March 22,
1898, at Omsk, Siberia. According to the application form
he filled up when applying for employment with the Shanghai
Municipal Police it appears that he left Russia in 1918 and
went to Manchuria where he served in the White Russian Army
during 1919 as an engineer on armoured trains. Following
the taking over of the Chinese Eastern Railway by the govern-
ment of the U.S.S.R. in 1924 he left Manchuria for Shanghai
arriving here in June of the same year. In Shanghai he was
employed with the restaurant Kavkaz, No. 86 Range Road, from
10.8.24 to 10.7.25, the Astor House Hotel from 10.7.25 to
August, 1925 and the French Municipal Police from 26.3.26 to
23.8.28. He was subsequently employed by Mr. Chang Zer-chung,
217 Machinery Street, Nantao, as a bodyguard until he joined
the Municipal Police. Upon enlistment he gave his profession
as a railway engineer and claimed to have a knowledge of
several languages including English, French, Polish and
Chinese.

On June 1, 1929, Silin was appointed Assistant Warder
No. 16 and was attached to the Amoy Road Gaol. He served in
this capacity until May 5, 1936 when he was compulsorily
retired for an offence in relation to the misuse of his wife's
passage money when proceeding on leave, contrary to the
Shanghai Municipal Council's Rules governing passages. During
his period of service with the Municipal Gaol he was reported
on ten occasions for offences of a purely disciplinary nature.

On November 16, 1935 he left Shanghai for Marseilles in
the s.s. "Chenonceaux" with the intention of proceeding to
Paraguay. While en route he called at the office of the

事由：英国驻上海总领事馆于1936年2月10日发来的公函，涉及前上海公共租界监狱第16号副看守员P.B.西林。
由特务督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由警司J.B.Rm转呈。

彼得·鲍里斯·西林，俄裔流亡者，1898年3月22日出生于西伯利亚鄂木斯克。根据他在申请受雇于上海公共租界工部局警务处时填写的申请表显示，他于1918年离开俄国，前往满洲，并于1919年间在白色俄国军队中担任装甲列车工程师。1924年苏联政府接管中东铁路后，他离开满洲前往上海，于同年6月抵达。在上海，他先后受雇于兰路（Range Road）86号的高加索餐厅（Kavkaz），任职期为1924年8月10日至1925年7月10日；汇中饭店（Astor House Hotel），任职期为1925年7月10日至1925年8月；以及法公董局警务处，任职期为1926年3月26日至1928年8月23日。此后，他在加入工部局警务处之前，受雇于南市机械街217号的张泽忠（Chang Zer-chung，音译）先生，担任保镖。入职时，他申报的职业为铁路工程师，并声称通晓包括英语、法语、波兰语和中文在内的多种语言。

1929年6月1日，西林被任命为第16号副看守员，派往厦门路监狱工作。他一直担任此职，直至1936年5月5日因违反上海公共租界工部局关于旅费的规定，在休假期间滥用其妻子的旅费而被强制退休。在工部局监狱服役期间，他曾十次因纯纪律性质的过失被记录在案。

1935年11月16日，他乘坐“谢农索号”（s.s. "Chenonceaux"）轮船离开上海前往马赛，意图随后前往巴拉圭。在途中，他拜访了

H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

10th February, 1930.

My dear Givens,

I should be much obliged for any information which
you may be able to give me on the subject of PETER BORIS SILIN,
now in Berlin, and until recently employed by the Shanghai
Municipal Police as a gaoler.

I am particularly anxious to know what his political
affiliations were, if any, and whether he was a gaoler at the
time when MORRISON was accused by Centrosojus of the misappro-
priation of $25,000. Silin now states that he went to
Europe on the same boat as Morrison who at the time had two
passports, the second being in the name of CHERMAN. Silin does
not give the name or date of sailing of this boat, but possibly
you can obtain this and check the accuracy of his remarks for me.
He further accuses Morrison of being a trusted Communist agent
and states that his (Morrison's) passage was booked to Paraguay
by the American Lloyd Co., but that he suddenly left the boat
at Suez.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
SHANGHAI.

（批：J.S. Roberts / J.H.R of 3/2）
（批：S2, For inquiry and report please.）
（批：J.H.S 11 FEB. 1930）

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

1930年2月10日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

如您能就彼得·鲍里斯·西林（PETER BORIS SILIN）一事向我提供任何信息，我将不胜感激。此人目前在柏林，直至最近还在上海公共租界工部局警务处担任狱卒。

我特别迫切想知道他是否有政治隶属关系，以及在莫里森（MORRISON）被中央消费合作总社指控挪用25,000美元时，西林是否担任狱卒。西林现在声称，他与莫里森乘坐同一艘船前往欧洲，当时莫里森持有两本护照，第二本名为CHERMAN。西林未提供该船的船名或启航日期，但或许您可以获取这些信息并为我核实其言论的准确性。他还指控莫里森是一名受信任的共产党特工，并称莫里森的船票是由美商劳埃德公司（American Lloyd Co.）预订至巴拉圭的，但莫里森在苏伊士突然离船。

此致

敬礼，
〔签名〕

T. P. 吉文斯先生，
上海。

（批注：J.S. Roberts / J.H.R 2月3日）
（批注：第二股，请调查并报告。）
（批注：J.H.S 1930年2月11日）

With reference to the request of Mr. North of H.B.M.
Passport Office regarding information re a Russian national
named Cilin, I have to state that this person is identical
with one Peter Borisovich Silin, Russian, born on March 22,
1898, at Omsk, Siberia.

Silin joined the Shanghai Municipal Police (Gaols)
on July 6, 1929 as assistant warder and on November 1, 1932
was promoted to the rank of warder.

In October, 1934, he proceeded on long leave and
upon return in April, 1935 resigned under pressure involuntarily from the force
on account of irregular expenditure of long leave passage money
provided for his wife.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records against
this individual either politically or criminally.

关于英国护照办公室诺思（North）先生请求提供有关一名名为Cilin的俄国国民的信息一事，兹说明此人与彼得·鲍里索维奇·西林（Peter Borisovich Silin）系同一人，俄国人，1898年3月22日出生于西伯利亚鄂木斯克。

西林于1929年7月6日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处（监狱部），担任副看守员，并于1932年11月1日晋升为看守员。

1934年10月，他休长假，1935年4月返回后，因违规使用为其妻子提供的长假旅费，被迫非自愿辞职。

工部局警务处档案中无任何关于此人的政治或犯罪记录。

Date May 9, 1935.

(Crime Branch) Office Notes

Deputy Commissioner (Crime Branch)

Mr. North of H.B.M. Passport Office requests
information re a Russian national named Cilin, who has
applied at the above office for permission to enter
Hongkong and who was formerly a member of the S.M.P.
I suggest this enquiry be referred to the
Special Branch.

H. Robertson
Personal Assistant.
9/5-

D.C. (C. Br.)
Passed to you please.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)）

S2,
For attention
Please. JAG
10 APR. 1935

D.S. Manact
11/5/35.

日期：1935年5月9日。

（刑事科）办公笔记

副警务处长（刑事科）

英国护照办公室的诺思先生请求提供有关一名名为Cilin的俄国国民的信息，此人曾向上述办公室申请进入香港的许可，且曾是上海公共租界工部局警务处成员。我建议将此查询转交特务科处理。

H. 罗伯逊
私人助理。
5月9日-

副警务处长（刑事科）
请转交给你。

（印：副警务处长（刑事科））

第二股，
请留意。
JAG
1935年4月10日

特务侦探 Manact
1935年5月11日。
